public_input_policy.window: 200 successive100ms rows; wrap only at recording boundary; retain missing/large ages and all innovation tails
public_input_policy.age_quantization: ceil to10ms; no age clipping; missing when requested state predates simulation history
public_input_policy.innovation_transfer: Add the recorded velocity second difference in m/s to candidate and delayed anchor during attack window; no sensor calibration or hard-bound claim

paired_inference: six shared seed clusters; descriptive scenario-level effects; no independent query-level population inference
scope: Joint history/authority/lifetime numerical confirmation; initial_false_context,authority_exceed,public_motion_innovation are declared negative controls. Nominal_authority is a deliberately weaker-bound ablation, not a fair robust baseline.
authority_ablation_note: nominal_authority intentionally usesE=1; robust arms useE=2.5. The frozen full estimator proposes a nominal point only; its scene/command premises are not inherited as safety authorization.
